greeting.body: Thank you for getting in touch. Your message has reached us.

whoReadsAlong.headline: Who reads your message
whoReadsAlong.body: Only the trained staff of the responsible counselling centre read your message. Everyone there is bound by confidentiality.

responseDeadline.headline: When you will get a reply
responseDeadline.body: You will receive a reply from a suitable contact person within {{deadlineDays}} working days.

modalityNote.body: The counselling takes place in writing, in this protected area. You can keep writing at any time.

noPersonalData.headline: Please do not send personal data
noPersonalData.body: Please do not send us your full name, your address or your phone number. We do not need any of that for the counselling.

emergencyNumbers.headline: If it cannot wait
emergencyNumbers.body: In an acute emergency you can reach Telefonseelsorge around the clock on 0800 111 0 111 or 0800 111 0 222, and the emergency services on 112.

dataProtection.body: How we handle your data is set out in the privacy policy.

emailNotification.headline: Notification by e-mail
emailNotification.body: You may leave an e-mail address, entirely voluntarily. We will then let you know as soon as a reply is there. The content of the counselling never appears in that e-mail.

accountProtection.headline: Your access, additionally protected
accountProtection.body: You can secure your access with a second factor, so that nobody else can get in.

closing.body: See you soon — we will get back to you.
